normalization: for each current sample and row, restrict to currently allowed observable/traversable feature destinations, then normalize positive weights
notes: All six rows intentionally identical: the policy does not condition feature preference on the previous feature.
Feature 0 is always observed in the registered base generator, so at least one informative feature is available.
Zero support for noise is exact only at alpha=1. For alpha<1 the uniform component gives noise positive probability when it is valid.
This is a probability-space mixture, NOT softmax(alpha*guided_logits); do not feed these weights as finite logits into the current ExactMaskedWalk.
Known noninformative features may be excluded by design, but improvement in finite-sample class-balanced accuracy is an empirical hypothesis, not a mathematical guarantee.
